criteria.requirement: Add webcolors.accessibility relative_luminance, contrast_ratio, meets_contrast and contrast_on. Implement the declared sRGB 0.04045 transfer breakpoint, weights .2126/.7152/.0722 and raw (Lmax+.05)/(Lmin+.05) ratio. Validate exact integer RGB channels; never silently clamp invalid measurements. Threshold 1..21 is explicit and finite; compare without rounding first. Ordinary luminance/ratio reject transparent RGBA. contrast_on accepts prior RGBA and an explicit opaque background, performs declared encoded-sRGB alpha compositing with nearest-byte half-up quantization and measures the resulting RGB; never guess a white background. Preserve legacy conversion and avoid claims that a color ratio certifies an entire UI.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
